objects.notes: figure box, window facing front, slightly rotated

sequence: Right arm tip just inside the back-right corner: lifts the back end so the box tilts on the front bar.
Left arm tip at the back-left corner to straighten the box if it yaws.
Repeat until the box stands vertically between the bars and slides down.
abort_if: Box ends up flat on both bars (詰み) – ask staff to reset
strategy.expected_motion: Back end rises, box rotates about the front bar and its front end drops into the gap.

explanation: This is a standard bridge setup (橋渡し). The box is heavy, so stand it up (縦ハメ) instead of trying to lift it: put one claw tip just inside the back end and alternate sides.
warnings: Arm power is not visible in the photo; check how much the box moves on the first play.
